proposals.subtype: PATCH to POST with MERGE override header
proposals.explanation: The policy changes PATCH requests to POST, sets X-HTTP-Method to MERGE and delegates all requests to the next policy.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: A standalone service-adaptation policy is implemented in the src helper layer alongside the separately referenced src/generated client/model tree, rather than inside that generated tree.

proposals.subtype: Secondary account hostname derivation
proposals.explanation: Parses the primary URL and appends -secondary to its first hostname segment only when the hostname has multiple segments, returning the modified URL string.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This standalone endpoint utility is implemented in the non-generated src helper layer next to the explicitly referenced generated model tree.

proposals.subtype: Context-sensitive OData interpolation string quoting
proposals.explanation: Escapes string values and encloses them in single quotes when the preceding template segment is nonempty and its trimmed text does not already end with a quote; returns non-string values unchanged.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The local helper is part of the implemented odata tagged-template convenience module publicly exported separately from the generated client/model code.

proposals.subtype: Double single quotes in OData literal values
proposals.explanation: Replaces every single quote with two single quotes.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The implemented escaping utility supports the separately exported non-protocol odata convenience helper.

proposals.subtype: Literal percent pre-encoding
proposals.explanation: Replaces all percent characters with %25. The supplied odata implementation does not call this helper.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This concrete encoding utility is implemented in the convenience helper module outside the separate generated tree.

proposals.subtype: Date interpolation to OData datetime literal
proposals.explanation: Converts Date objects to datetime-quoted ISO strings and returns other inputs unchanged.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The local implementation belongs to the non-protocol tagged-template helper layer.

proposals.subtype: OData template assembly with string/date adapters
proposals.explanation: Interleaves template segments and values, applies string quote handling followed by Date encoding to each supplied value and joins the resulting array into a filter string.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This is an implemented public convenience helper exported by src/index.ts, separate from the generated model/client layer referenced by the package.

proposals.subtype: Account SAS permission flag parser
proposals.explanation: Maps r/w/d/l/a/u characters to query/write/delete/list/add/update flags, rejecting other characters with RangeError.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The local SAS helper layer implements permission parsing used by the public SAS generator, rather than a generated REST operation.

proposals.subtype: Canonical account SAS permission ordering
proposals.explanation: Emits enabled permission flags in rwdlau order.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This implemented formatter is called by the local account SAS signing helper outside the generated REST tree.

proposals.subtype: Account SAS resource type parser
proposals.explanation: Maps s/c/o to service/container/object flags and throws RangeError for other characters.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The SAS helper layer implements this local parser used in account signature construction.

proposals.subtype: Canonical account SAS resource type ordering
proposals.explanation: Serializes enabled resource type flags in sco order.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The concrete local formatter supports SAS signing outside the generated REST layer.

proposals.subtype: Account SAS service flag parser
proposals.explanation: Maps b/f/q/t to blob/file/queue/table flags and throws RangeError for other characters.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The local SAS generator uses this explicit parser in the non-protocol helper layer.

proposals.subtype: SAS service formatting with table-only default
proposals.explanation: Defaults omitted services to table=true and emits enabled flags in btqf order.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The formatter is explicitly implemented in the local SAS helper module, not a generated REST response serializer.

proposals.subtype: Canonical account SAS input and signature assembly
proposals.explanation: Normalizes permission/service/resource flags, defaults the service version and builds newline-separated account/name/time/IP/protocol/version signing input with a trailing newline, calls the platform HMAC helper and constructs SasQueryParameters.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The standalone SAS helper implements local canonicalization and invokes a platform signing utility outside the separate generated REST tree.

proposals.subtype: Account SAS credential validation and one-hour defaults
proposals.explanation: Requires a named-key credential, defaults permissions to rl, resource types to sco and services to table; omitted expiry becomes one hour after now, and normalized options are passed to the signature generator and string encoder.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: src/sas/index.ts publicly exports this implemented local SAS convenience function separately from the generated client.

proposals.subtype: Stored-policy-aware table SAS defaults
proposals.explanation: Requires a named-key credential and supplies read permission plus a one-hour expiry only when there is no truthy identifier and those respective inputs are absent, then invokes the table signature generator and returns its encoded token.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The public SAS entry point is an implemented local helper outside the separately referenced generated REST tree.

proposals.subtype: Optional single-IP or IP-range string formatting
proposals.explanation: Returns an empty string for absent input, start-end when end is truthy, otherwise the start string.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This implemented helper participates in local SAS canonicalization and query serialization outside the generated REST code.

proposals.subtype: SAS IP range getter returns a shallow copy
proposals.explanation: Returns a new start/end object for a stored IP range or undefined when absent.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The getter is part of the concrete local SAS query abstraction used by the handwritten signing helpers.

proposals.subtype: SAS parameter state and conditional delegation metadata initialization
proposals.explanation: Retains version/signature/options including Date and IP-range references; copies delegation key metadata, preauthorized object ID and correlation ID only when userDelegationKey is present.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: This concrete constructor belongs to the local SAS signing/query helper layer rather than a generated service wire model.

proposals.subtype: Ordered SAS fields with time and IP formatting
proposals.explanation: Walks an ordered key list and appends supported SAS version/service/resource/protocol/time/IP/identifier/delegation/permission/signature/table/key-bound fields, applying the date and IP helpers before joining pairs with ampersands. Keys listed without switch cases are not emitted.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The local SAS abstraction directly implements token query formatting outside generated REST operations.

proposals.subtype: Skip empty SAS values and percent-encode query pairs
proposals.explanation: Skips falsy values, applies encodeURIComponent independently to key/value and appends nonempty encoded pairs.
proposals.handwrittenRationale: The implemented private helper is called by the local SAS token formatter.

encodePercent is implemented and exported from odata.ts, but no supplied call site uses it and the package index does not export it. Its effect on a shipped SDK behavior cannot be established from this evidence.
encodeDate is a private conversion step within the same publicly exported odata template helper, not an independently established customization instance.
The public tagged-template helper is supported, including its private string and Date adapters; these form one behavior. Generating this particular public helper from TypeSpec is not established.
